description: Javastraat 95-121 (BAG 1912-13): 6.0 m brown brick fronts over a shop, three 3.0 m upper storeys with round-arched windows under light brick arch rings (a wide window, a balcony door, a close pair of narrow windows), iron-railed projecting balconies at the balcony door on the two upper storeys, a white gutter at 12.2 m under a black slate mansard with one white pediment dormer over the balcony axis

match.note: BAG 1912 on 12 of the 14 Javastraat 95-121 pands, 3DBAG eaves 11.9-12.5 m (the mansard ridge 14.3-14.9 m). The 3DBAG roof rise 2.4 m separates the mansard from the Djambistraat pitched type (ridge 15.6 m over 12.7 m)

mansard-dormer.note: Javastraat 97, 99: a white pediment dormer 1.6 m wide, 13.2-14.3 m, over the balcony axis on the black slate roof (a 70 degree front slope from the 12.2 m gutter to about 14.4 m); drawn as a dormer on the type's attic roof (roofFront mansard put the dormer through a roof plane the recipe roof does not have: audit opening-outside 10.3 m2 and 1.9 m2 of coplanar slate)

roof.evidence: Javastraat 95-121: the black slate mansard 12.2-14.0 m behind the gutter, a steep (about 70 degree) front slope under 3DBAG ridges of 14.3-14.9 m over eaves of 12.0-12.5 m; the face-wide 30 degree recipe attic put the pediment dormer through a roof plane that does not exist

rhythm.bays: 4 axes: wide arched window, balcony door, two narrow arched windows
rhythm.symmetry: none; the narrow pair on the right of every front on the strip
rhythm.roofline: white gutter, a black slate mansard, one pediment dormer

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2023-01-02, 40 px/m, gridded: pand 6.0 m; window heads 5.37, 8.4, 11.4 m, sills 3.25, 6.25, 9.25 m (2.1 m tall); wide arched window 1.0 m at 1.4 m from the left edge, balcony door 1.0 m at 3.15 m, narrow pair 0.6 m at 4.7 and 5.5 m; iron balconies projecting under the storey 2 and 3 doors; white gutter 12.2 m; mansard 12.2-14.0 m; dormer apex 14.3 m; wall median #6b5c50 over 14 pands
